title: Gospel of Thomas — Dilley / Coptic SCRIPTORIUM annotated edition
attribution: Paul C. Dilley (edition and primary annotations); Coptic SCRIPTORIUM. Annotation/metadata contributions by Caroline T. Schroeder, Lydia Bremer-McCollum, and Amir Zeldes. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
notes: Primary Phase 1 Coptic Thomas target (JAK-30). Pin SCRIPTORIUM corpora release v6.2.0 TreeTagger SGML (*.tt), which carries recoverable orig (manuscript-oriented) and norm (analysis) layers. Packaged import is UNIT-LEVEL ONLY (TextUnits thomas.0-thomas.114) — not token-complete and not alignment-ready; full SCRIPTORIUM token/group relationships remain for later work under JAK-32 AlignmentDocument / v1 ID grammar. Portal: https://data.copticscriptorium.org/texts/thomasgospel/gospel-of-thomas/ . Zenodo archive for the corpora release: doi:10.5281/zenodo.17917497. Local path after setup: data/downloads/dilley-thomas/thomas_gospel.tt . Redistributable import under data/sources/thomas/. Do not substitute Layton/Attridge or Bethge continuous critical Greek. Facsimile images are not part of this grant.
text_source: Nag Hammadi Codex II (NHAM.02) via Dilley SCRIPTORIUM edition
